User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user. (doc id = uid from Firebase Auth)

gender.description: The user's gender (male, female, other, or prefer_not_to_say).

role.description: The user's role (user, vendor, or admin).

region.description: The region the user is located in.

favourites.description: References to favourite Vendors. (Relationship: User 1:N Vendor)

collectedPromotions.description: An array of active promotion collections, each being a unique instance.

redeemedPromotions.description: An array of unique promotion IDs that the user has redeemed, for display in their history.

uncollectedPromotions.description: An array of promotion IDs that the user has uncollected.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the user was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the user was last updated.

Vendor.description: Represents a vendor in the application.

normalizedName.description: A normalized version of the name for case-insensitive, punctuation-agnostic lookups.

searchableName.description: Lowercase version of the name for case-insensitive search.

region.description: The region the vendor is located in.

lat.description: The latitude of the vendor's location.

lng.description: The longitude of the vendor's location.

city.description: The city the vendor is located in.

state.description: The state the vendor is located in.

country.description: The country the vendor is located in.

googlePlaceId.description: The unique ID from the Google Places API.

googleReviewCount.description: The number of reviews for the vendor from Google.

photos.description: Array of photo URLs from Google Places.

priceLevel.description: The price level of the place, from 0 to 4.

types.description: Array of types assigned by Google (e.g., 'car_wash').

googleLastSyncedAt.description: Timestamp of the last sync with Google Places.

zippRating.description: The vendor's internal rating from Zipp users.

zippReviewCount.description: The number of internal reviews from Zipp users.

searchableTags.description: Lowercase version of tags for case-insensitive search.

dedupeConfidence.description: A 0-1 score for the AI's confidence in a deduplication match.

googleSyncLocked.description: A manual override to prevent automatic updates from Google sync.

trialStartedAt.description: Timestamp of when the vendor's trial period started.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the vendor was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the vendor was last updated.

modulesAvailable.description: List of modules available for this category.

defaultModules.description: Modules enabled by default when vendor selects this category.

fieldsSchema.description: Schema definition when creating a vendor of this category.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the category was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the category was last updated.

Promotion.description: Represents a promotion offered by a vendor.

startAt.description: Timestamp of when the promotion starts.

endAt.description: Timestamp of when the promotion ends.

terms.description: The terms and conditions of the promotion.

redemptionType.description: The type of redemption for the promotion (qr, code, in-store).

quota.description: The number of redemptions allowed for the promotion.

redemptions.description: An array of individual redemption events for analytics.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the promotion was created.

createdBy.description: The user who created the promotion.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the promotion was last updated.

TodaysHotDeals.title: Today's Hot Deals
TodaysHotDeals.description: A singleton document containing a curated list of promotions to be featured for the day.

promotions.description: An array of full promotion objects.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the list was last updated.

Offering.title: Offering
Offering.description: Represents a product or service offered by a vendor.

searchableName.description: Lowercase version of name for case-insensitive search.

isActive.description: Whether the offering is currently available.

pricingModel.description: The pricing model for a service.

currency.description: The currency of the offering's price.

inStock.description: The stock status of the product.

sku.description: The stock keeping unit of the product.

customFields.description: Dynamic fields based on the vendor's main category.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the offering was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the offering was last updated.

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Represents an order placed by a user.

items.description: List of items in the order.

totalAmount.description: The total amount of the order.

currency.description: The currency of the order's total amount.

status.description: The status of the order (pending, ready_for_pickup, collected, cancelled).

pickupCode.description: The pickup code for the order.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the order was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the order was last updated.

Booking.title: Booking
Booking.description: Represents a booking made by a user.

dateTime.description: Timestamp of when the booking is scheduled.

status.description: The status of the booking (pending, confirmed, in_progress, completed, cancelled).

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the booking was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the booking was last updated.

condition.description: The condition of the listed item.

price.description: The price of the listed item.

currency.description: The currency of the listing's price.

status.description: The status of the listing (open, sold, removed).

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the listing was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the listing was last updated.

Offer.title: Offer
Offer.description: Represents an offer made on a listing.

status.description: The status of the offer (pending, accepted, rejected).

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the offer was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the offer was last updated.

Review.title: Review
Review.description: Represents a review written by a user for a vendor.

vendorId.description: Reference to the Vendor being reviewed.

userId.description: Reference to the User who wrote the review.

userName.description: Denormalized name of the user for display.

userAvatar.description: Denormalized avatar URL of the user.

text.description: The written content of the review.

ScrapeCache.description: Represents the cache for scraped data.

cacheId.description: Unique identifier for the cache entry.

region.description: The region for which the data was scraped.

source.description: The source of the scraped data (e.g., google_places, serper).

apiResponse.description: The raw JSON response from the API.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the cache entry was created.

expiresAt.description: Timestamp of when the cache entry expires.

notes.description: Additional notes about the cache entry.

GeocodeCache.title: GeocodeCache
GeocodeCache.description: Caches results from the geocoding service to reduce API calls.

Redemption.title: Redemption
Redemption.description: Represents a redemption of a promotion.

redeemedAt.description: Timestamp of when the promotion was redeemed.

method.description: The method of redemption (qr, code, in-store).

planId.description: The ID of the subscription plan.

status.description: The status of the subscription (active, past_due, cancelled).

stripeSubscriptionId.description: The ID of the subscription in Stripe.

startedAt.description: Timestamp of when the subscription started.

endedAt.description: Timestamp of when the subscription ended.

activityLogConfig.description: Configuration to enable/disable specific activity logs.

UserActivityLog.title: User Activity Log
UserActivityLog.description: Records user activities for analytics and reporting.

logId.description: Unique identifier for the log entry.

userId.description: Reference to the user who performed the activity.

data.description: Contextual data about the activity (e.g., search query, vendorId).

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the activity occurred.

Analytics.title: Analytics
Analytics.description: Stores aggregated analytics data for Firestore usage.

month.description: The month of the analytics data in YYYY-MM format.

reads.description: Total number of document reads for the month.

writes.description: Total number of document writes for the month.

deletes.description: Total number of document deletes for the month.

ZippHighlights.description: A singleton document containing a list of full vendor objects to be featured as highlights.

vendors.description: An array of 8 full vendor objects.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the list was last updated.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore data structure is designed to support a modular, role-based super-app, Zipp. Key considerations include: 

1.  **Authorization Independence:** Denormalization is used extensively to avoid `get()` calls in security rules. For example, the `users` collection stores the user's `role`, eliminating the need to fetch user data when validating operations on other collections.  This makes authorization rules simpler, robust, and easily debuggable. The `vendorId` is included in related entities like `promotions`, `orders`, `bookings`, and `redemptions` to avoid needing to fetch the parent vendor document for authorization.
2.  **Structural Segregation:** Data with different access requirements is separated into distinct collections. User-generated content (listings) and vendor-managed content (promotions, offerings) are stored in separate collections, each with appropriate security rules. Offerings and Reviews are now a sub-collection of vendors.
3.  **Access Modeling:** User-owned data (listings, orders, bookings) are stored under the `/users/{userId}` path, enabling path-based authorization. Vendor-owned data is stored in a subcollection under the vendor document, which allows for strong ownership rules.
4.  **Performance Optimization:** Singleton documents like `featuredMerchants` and `todaysHotDeals` cache curated data, populated by scheduled Cloud Functions. This avoids costly, scalable queries on every homepage load, thus reducing read operations and preventing quota exhaustion. With the removal of the root /offerings collection, search performance is now tied directly to Firestore's indexing capabilities on the /vendors collection, simplifying the architecture.

Specific denormalization strategies:

*   User `role` is stored directly in the `users` collection, so rules can validate user roles without additional reads.
*   `vendorId` is included on all vendor-related documents to allow validation of vendor ownership without reading the vendor document.
* A `geocodeCache` collection has been added to cache results from the Nominatim API, reducing API calls and improving performance. The document ID is the normalized search query.
* A `userActivityLogs` collection has been added to record user actions. It is write-only for users to ensure data integrity.
* An `analytics` collection has been added to store monthly aggregated usage data. It is read-only for admins.
